     Methods:
    GetLineWidth(Text)
    GetTextHeight(Text, Dialog = nil, X = 0, IgnoreStrRightSymbol = false [MM7+]) In place of Dialog you can pass a table in form of {Left, Top, Width, Height}.
    Calls WordWrap internally and stores the result in Game.WordWrappedText.
    WordWrap(Text, Dialog = nil, X = 0, IgnoreStrRightSymbol = false [MM7+], ReturnPointer = false) Returns text with extra line breaks inserted.
    In place of Dialog you can pass a table in form of {Left, Top, Width, Height}.
    If ReturnPointer = true, returns Game.WordWrappedTextBytes table instead of Lua string. You can then pass this table to any of the font methods.
    Draw(Text, Dialog = nil, X = 0, Y = 0, Color = 0, ShadowColor [MM7+], Bottom [MM7+], Opaque [MM7+]) In place of Dialog you can pass a table in form of {Left, Top, Width, Height}.
    If X is 0, in MM6 and MM7 it gets set to 12 by the function.
    Passing 0 as Color would draw text using default color.
    Unless Bottom is specified, it calls WordWrap internally and stores the result in Game.WordWrappedText.
    Bottom is specified in absolute coordinates, not relative to dialog. When specified, the text doesn't get word-wrapped, but doesn't get drawn below its value. If not specified, text gets ward-wrapped when it exceeds dialog width horizontally, but is not limited vertically.
    DrawLimited(Text, Dialog = nil, Width, X = 0, Y = 0, Color = 0, TruncateStart = false) In place of Dialog you can pass a table in form of {Left, Top, Width, Height}.
    X should not be 0 in MM6 and MM7, because it then gets set to 12 by the function if text fits and is kept at '0 if it doesn't.
    Passing 0 as Color would draw text using default color.
    If TruncateStart is true, end of the string is kept and beginning is truncated to fit the required size.
    Calls WordWrap internally and stores the result in Game.WordWrappedText.
    DrawCentered(Text, Dialog = nil, X = 0, Y = 0, Color = 0, ReduceLineHeight = 3) In place of Dialog you can pass a table in form of {Left, Top, Width, Height}.
    Passing 0 as Color would draw text using default color.
    Calls WordWrap internally and stores the result in Game.WordWrappedText.

    IsAgainst(Mon2) [MM7+] Returns aggression number between 0 and 4. If Mon2 isn't specified, attitude towards party is checked.

    GotHit(By = 4, ResetAnimation = false) Shows monster's getting hit animation, produces sound and boosts aggression level. By is the attacker object reference value.
    PlaySound(SoundIndex) [MM7+] SoundIndex is from 0 to 3 or any of these corresponding strings: "Attack", "Die", "GotHit", "Fidget"

     Methods:
    HasFile(name) Does a slow search for a file. For sorted LOD archives FindFile works faster.
    FindFile(name, unsorted = false) Finds a file and returns file stream address or 0 if file isn't found. By default performs fast binary search. Pass unsorted = true when searching in Game.GamesLod and Game.SaveGameLod, because these archives aren't sorted lexicographically and thus binary search can't be used for them.
    Returned file stream can be used in Game.FileRead, Game.FileSeek and Game.FileTell functions. Its position is set to the beginning of specified file.

    Data Tables

    Text tables in Data\Tables that the MMMerge and Waffel Edition scripts read, grouped by the script that reads them.


    Data\ Tables (MMExtension)

    Tables of the base MMExtension, loaded by General\DataTables.lua. See More on Data Tables in the base help; MMMerge only enlarges them.

     Tables:

    Base tables

    		 Class HP SP, Class Skills, Class Starting Skills, Class Starting Stats, House Movies, SFT, DecList, PFT, IFT, TFT, Chest, Overlay, ObjList, MonList, Sounds, Tile, Tile2, Tile3, Monster Kinds, Spells2, Town Portal, Transport Index, Transport Locations. Tile, Tile2 and Tile3 are the tile sets of MM8, MM7 and MM6 maps. Class tables have a column for every class of the merge, Class Starting Stats one for every race ("Might 11/25": start / maximum, "+ add" rows: points per click). Class Skills cells: mastery letters B, E, M, G, - none.


    General\ 1_TownPortalSwitch.lua, 2_OutdoorTravels.lua

    [MMMerge]

     Tables:

    TownPortalSwitch.txt


    #, Map, X, Y, Z, Direction, LookAngle, IconName, Icon X, Icon Y, IconWidth, IconHeight, QBitIndex, Description     		Town Portal destinations of every continent: map, position, direction, icon and its place, the quest bit that opens it and the description. A row starting with @ names the screen picture and the first quest bit.

    Outdoor travels.txt


    Key map, Up, Side, Days, Down, Side, Days, Left, Side, Days, Right, Side, Days, StraightTravel, Notes     		Walking off the edge of an outdoor map: for each side the map reached, the side you arrive on and the days it takes; StraightTravel. Read into Game.OutdoorTravels.

MH Offset X/Y     		Per doll type: which items it shows (x / - for Bow, Armor, Helm, Belt, Boots, Cloak, Weapon), the hand picture offsets (RHo, RHc, RHf, LHo, LHc, LHf: open, closed, fist) and the main and off hand weapon offsets. Read into Game.CharacterDollTypes.

    Character voices.txt


    Soundtype/Voicesetid, 0, 1 ...     		One row per sound type (several rows for the variants), one column per voice set: the sound ids. Read into Game.CharacterVoices.


    Structs\ RacialSkills.lua, RaceHPSP.lua, Resistances.lua

    [MMMerge]

     Tables:

    Race Skills.txt


    #, Note, Staff (0) ... one per skill     		One row per race, one column per skill. A cell is Min/Add/Max/Bonus/Auto: the lowest mastery the race has, mastery steps added to the class limit, the highest mastery, bonus skill points, and whether the skill is learned at the start (1). - keeps the class default, 0 forbids the skill; masteries as 0..4 or mastery letters B, E, M, G. Read into Game.RaceSkills.

    RaceHPSP.txt


    #, Note, HPBase, HPFactor, SPBase, SPFactor     		HP and SP changes of a race to its class numbers: HPBase, HPFactor, SPBase, SPFactor; factors may be fractions like -4/4.

    Resistances.txt


    #, Race, RaceName, Class, ClassName, Resistance, Value     		Resistance bonuses: race (-1 any) and class (-1 any), the resistance number (const.Damage) and its value. Read into Game.Resistances.


    Structs\ RemoveHouseRulesLimits.lua

    [MMMerge]

     Tables:

    House rules.txt


    Index by type, Quality, Items1..Items4, ...     		Sections (a title row such as "Weapon shops Standart") with one row per shop of that type: the treasure level and up to four item types it sells; armor shops have shelf and case parts; guilds, training halls and Arcomage taverns have their own columns. Read into Game.HouseRules.


    Structs\ RemoveItemsLimits.lua

    [MMMerge]

     Tables:

    Potion settings.txt


    Pot Id, Item Id, Required mastery, Drinkable, Usable, Notes     		Per potion: its item, the Alchemy mastery needed to make it, drinkable and usable (x / -).

    Reagent settings.txt


    Reagent Id, Item Id, Result item id, Notes     		Per reagent: its item and the potion it makes. Read into Game.ReagentSettings.

    Complex item pictures.txt


    Id, Item id, Notes, X/Y per doll type     		Paperdoll positions of armor, helms, belts, boots and cloaks for every doll type (t0..t5: X, Y). Edited in game with the Paperdoll Tuner. Read into Game.ArmorPicsCoords.

    Complex item pictures offsets.txt


    Portrait id, Item id, X, Y     		Extra offsets of an item picture for one portrait (-1: all).

    Changes to the original help

    Corrections

    • Spelling: achive → archive, anmation → animation, concious → conscious, deafults → defaults, dirrectory → directory, eventhough → even though, exect → exact, figet → fidget, fulscreen → fullscreen, funciton → function, guraded → guarded, indeces → indices, initilized → initialized, inteface → interface, mutiple → multiple, pacth → patch, ratains → retains, sctrucure → structure, seemlessly → seamlessly, signinficant → significant, sipmlify → simplify, thay → they, Additonal → Additional.
    • Game.Resume and Game.Resume2: "if the the game" → "if the game".
    • ItemsTxtItem.Skill linked to the missing const.Skill; now const.Skills.
    • The CalcStatBonusByItems example used const.Skill.EarthMagic, which raises an error; now const.Skills.EarthMagic.
    • The shelf example (Map events) called Game.StatusText, which doesn't exist; now Game.ShowStatusText (2 places).
    • Faces.Update linked to a non-existent UpdateFaces event; it raises BeforeUpdateFaces and AfterUpdateFaces.
    • Player.HasItemBonus: broken Bonus2 link and a missing full stop.
    • MapMonster.FramesGotHit and SoundGotHit: their "Same as ..." notes had turned into broken links; now they are descriptions.

    Added entries

    • Events: GetItemByRightClick added to Core\events.lua.
    • Undocumented base functions: bit.And/Or/Xor/Not, bit.AndNot, bit.ToTable, bit.FromTable, number methods, os.rename, PrintToFile, RefillNPCTopics, UpdateEventJustHint.
    • Fields and notes of the merge on Game, Party, Map and Item: Game.PlayersExtra, Party.SpellBuffs2, Party.Debuffs, Game.SpeedModifiers, Game.PartyLight, Game.TurnBasedState, Game.TurnBasedQueue, Game.NPCNewsTopics, Game.GlobalTxt (note), Game.TransTxt (note), Map.BloodSplats, Party.DaysWithoutRest, Game.CharacterPortraits, Game.CharacterDollTypes, Game.CharacterVoices, Game.StatConditionModifiers, Game.CurrentCharPortrait, Game.HouseRules, Game.HousesExtra, Game.ShopItems (note), Game.ShopSpecialItems (note), Game.GuildItems (note), Game.GuildAssortIds, Game.GuildNextRefill2, Game.ShopNextRefill (note), Game.ShopTheftExpireTime (note), Game.TransportIndex (note), Game.ArmorPicsCoords, Game.MixPotions, Game.ReagentSettings, Game.MessageScrolls, Game.ItemsChanceByLevelSum, Game.ItemsStdBonusChanceByLevel, Game.ItemsSpcBonusChanceByLevel, Game.ClassesExtra, Game.Races (note), Game.RaceSkills, Game.Resistances, Game.CustomRaceClassNames, Game.CharSelection, Game.ContinentSettings, Game.Bolster, Game.OutdoorTravels, Game.NPCNames (note), Game.NPCProf, Game.NPCProfessions, Game.NPCPersonalities, Game.MapNews, Game.ContinentNews, Game.ProfessionNews, Game.TeacherTopics, Game.MonsterPortraits, Game.HousesByMaps, Game.BlvEntrances, Game.HouseExtraExitTopic, Game.HouseExtraExitNPCDummy, Game.UISets, Game.ItemSounds, Game.SmallerPotionBottles, Game.FrameLimit, Game.MapMusicSets, Game.SetWeather, Game.SetMapNote, Game.TransformToZombie, Game.RecountFoundArtifacts, Game.CountItemBonuses, Game.GetMonstersInSight, Game.UnloadPalettes, Game.ReInitSprites, Game.ReInitSpriteEvent, Game.PrintEndCard, Game.LastCreatedObject, Game.SetFrameLimit, Item.Material.
    • Undocumented fields: Game.DelayedFaceAnimation, TravelInfo.OldMapIndex (merge layout), Item.Material (merge).
    • Missing structure structs.MissileDirection (MonsterCastSpell linked to it). Merge structures: ArcomageRule, ArmorPicsCoords, ArmorShopRule, BloodSplat, CharacterDollType, CharacterPortrait, CharacterVoices, EquipCoordinates, EquipCoordsCloak, HouseRules, HousesExtra, PartyLight, PlayerExtra, ReagentSettings, ShopRep, ShopRule, SpcAttack, TurnBasedQueueItem, TurnBasedState, WeaponShopRule.
